content.title: New bar set for Harvest Moon-type games
content.description:
Stardew Valley takes elements of Harvest Moon, Rune factory and animal crossing and then becomes better than all three. Bold statement, huh? Here's why.

Firstly, the amount of content this game  has is astounding. You have farming, fishing, mining, foraging, combat, NPCs, quests, special events...
